mods.description:
A window of everything your jobs can use now: magic by school, job abilities, weapon skills and pet commands, with costs and recasts; a click uses one (the action menu add-ons).

//actions opens the window
mods.name: Action Panel

mods.description:
Writes down who is at an event: your party and alliance, and players nearby, with the time, to a file (the linkshell attendance add-ons).

//attend [note]
mods.name: Attendance

mods.description: Event messages that wait for a key move on by themselves after a few seconds (the text auto-advance add-ons).
mods.name: Text Auto-Advance

mods.name: Battle Text

mods.name: Camera Range

mods.name: Casket Solver

mods.description: A grid of buttons over the party list: a row per member, a column per spell you choose; a click casts it on them (the click-to-cast add-ons).
mods.name: Cast Grid

mods.name: Chat Alerts

mods.name: Chat Filter

mods.description: Switches for the game's built-in waits and a few display choices (the config and delay add-ons).
mods.name: Client Tweaks

mods.name: Clock

mods.name: Cutscene Speed

mods.description:
The damage your party dealt since the first hit after a reset.

/dps
/dps reset starts again
mods.name: DPS

Cancels your status effects by name or id from a command, for macros (the cancel add-ons).

//cancel <effect>[, <effect>...] (a name, a name with *, or an id)

The bags holding each item whose name has the words, the account's other characters' too (the find-all add-ons).

/find <words>

mods.name: Focus and Last Target

mods.description:
Your harvesting, logging, mining and excavation this session: tries, success rate, broken tools and what you got (the gathering add-ons).

//gather reset
mods.name: Gathering Log

mods.description:
The totals of the stats on everything you wear, from the items' own descriptions and their augments (the gear stat add-ons).

//gearstats opens or closes the window
mods.name: Gear Stats

A trial weapon's weapon skill points toward its unlock, shown while it is highlighted in a game list and listed by command (the latent checker add-ons).

Treasure Hunter on your target, what each kind of monster has dropped this session, and the treasure pool's time left (the loot tracker add-ons).

mods.name: Minimap

mods.description: A box on screen with what nearby monsters ready or start casting, a sound for the moves you watch, and an alert when a monster you watch for comes near (the monster alert add-ons).
mods.name: Monster Alerts

Multibox Control

Controller crossbars: hold LT or RT and the d-pad and face buttons use that side's eight actions, set per job (the crossbar add-ons).

//padbars opens or closes the setup window

mods.description: Accepts party invites from the players you list and invites players who send you a chosen word in a tell (the auto-invite and auto-join add-ons).
mods.name: Party Tools

mods.description: The modern UI's chip over the cast bar: the spell, weapon skill, ability or item asked for while the server has not answered, its refusal in the server's words, or that no answer came.
mods.name: Pending Actions

mods.name: Pet Status

mods.description: Your HP, MP and TP as large bars near the middle of the screen (the player bar add-ons).
mods.name: Player Bars

mods.name: Quick Play

mods.name: Range Rings

mods.description: The Fields or Grounds of Valor regime in force and your kills, in a window beside the timers.
mods.name: Training Regime

mods.name: Roll Helper
Screen Capture
Screen Notes

Adds your session's total to each skill-up line, and lists your skills, their caps and today's gains (the skill-up tracker add-ons).

mods.name: Steady Cast

mods.name: Battle Suggestions

mods.name: Swing Timer

mods.name: Synthesis Amount

mods.description: A large HP bar for your target near the top of the screen, with what it is readying or casting (the enemy bar add-ons).

mods.name: Target Debuffs

Tells you when the weather you are waiting for starts or ends, and can tell your party (the weather add-ons).

Experience, limit and capacity points with their rates per hour, in a window on a screen edge (the point-watch add-ons).
